countingPolicy: Groups and rows overlap. No source-count sum or rendering percentage is application coverage.

healthHandoff.countingPolicy: Health scenarios supplement the preserved ledger; period-form protocol IDs bind to existing slash-form IDs without adding operations.

controls.markup: <button ngbDropdownToggle type="button" class="chain-toggle" aria-haspopup="true" aria-label="Select blockchain">

<button ngbDropdownItem type="button" *ngFor="let chain of explorerChains" class="chain-option"
          [class.active]="activeChain === chain" (click)="switchChain(chain)">

<button ngbDropdownToggle type="button" class="network-toggle" aria-haspopup="true"
        i18n-aria-label="master-page.select-network" aria-label="Select network">
<textarea formControlName="txHash" class="form-control" rows="5" i18n-placeholder="transaction.hex" placeholder="Transaction hex">
<textarea formControlName="txs" class="form-control" rows="5" i18n-placeholder="transaction.test-transactions" placeholder="Comma-separated list of raw transactions">

<input type="number" class="form-control input-dark" formControlName="maxfeerate" id="maxfeerate"
          [value]="10000" placeholder="10,000 s/vb" [class]="{invalid: invalidMaxfeerate}">

<input type="number" class="form-control input-dark" formControlName="maxburnamount" id="maxburnamount"
          [value]="0" placeholder="0 sat" [class]="{invalid: invalidMaxburnamount}">
<button [disabled]="isLoadingPackage" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary mr-2" i18n="shared.submit-transactions|Submit Package">

calls.expression:
this.apiService.submitPackage$(txs, maxfeerate === 0.1 ? null : maxfeerate, maxburnamount === 0 ? null : maxburnamount)
      .subscribe

controls.markup: <textarea formControlName="txs" class="form-control" rows="5" i18n-placeholder="transaction.test-transactions" placeholder="Comma-separated list of raw transactions">

<input type="number" class="form-control input-dark" formControlName="maxfeerate" id="maxfeerate"
        [value]="10000" placeholder="10,000 s/vb" [class]="{invalid: invalidMaxfeerate}">
<button [disabled]="isLoading" type="submit" class="btn btn-primary mr-2" i18n="shared.test-transactions|Test Transactions">
<input type="text" class="form-control font-monospace small mb-1" [(ngModel)]="sigA" placeholder="Sig A" />
<input type="text" class="form-control font-monospace small" [(ngModel)]="sigB" placeholder="Sig B" />
<input id="outputHexInput" type="text" [(ngModel)]="outputHex" placeholder="Raw output hex or outpoint txid:vout..." />
<textarea id="consignmentInput" [(ngModel)]="consignmentHex" rows="4" placeholder="rgb:consignment:... or hex data">

<textarea
            class="form-control font-monospace"
            rows="5"
            [(ngModel)]="rawTransactionsInput"
            placeholder="Paste raw transaction hexes (one per line or comma separated)..."
            aria-label="Raw transaction hex inputs"
          >

<textarea
                id="psbt-input"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                rows="4"
                [(ngModel)]="psbtInput"
                placeholder="Paste PSBT hex or base64..."
              >

<input
                id="spvTxid"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace text-break"
                [(ngModel)]="spvTxid"
                placeholder="Enter 64-character txid..."
              />

<input
                id="spvBlockHash"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace text-break"
                [(ngModel)]="spvBlockHash"
                placeholder="Enter 64-character block hash..."
              />

<input
                id="sigAddress"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace text-break"
                [(ngModel)]="sigAddress"
                placeholder="bc1q..."
              />

<textarea
              id="sigPayload"
              class="form-control font-monospace text-break"
              rows="3"
              [(ngModel)]="sigPayload"
              placeholder="Base64 or hex signature payload..."
            >

<button
              *ngIf="sigAddress || sigMessage || sigPayload"
              type="button"
              class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary"
              (click)="resetSig()"
            >

<input
              type="text"
              class="form-control form-control-sm font-monospace"
              style="min-width: 200px; max-width: 320px;"
              [(ngModel)]="searchTxid"
              placeholder="Search txid propagation..."
              aria-label="Search txid propagation"
            />

<input
                id="rootEntity"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace text-break"
                [(ngModel)]="rootEntity"
                placeholder="Enter root txid or address..."
              />

<input
              type="text"
              class="form-control form-control-sm"
              placeholder="Filter labels or addresses..."
              [(ngModel)]="searchFilter"
              aria-label="Filter labels"
            />

<input
                  id="newKeyLabelInput"
                  type="text"
                  class="form-control"
                  [(ngModel)]="newKeyLabel"
                  placeholder="e.g. Production Ingestion Service"
                />

<textarea
                id="sqlQueryInput"
                class="form-control font-monospace mb-3"
                rows="5"
                [(ngModel)]="sqlQuery"
                placeholder="SELECT txid, fee_sats, feerate FROM mempool_transactions LIMIT 20"
              >

<input
              id="decodeInput"
              type="text"
              class="form-control font-monospace text-break"
              [(ngModel)]="decodeInput"
              placeholder="Paste OP_RETURN 6a5d... or witness envelope..."
            />

<input
              type="text"
              class="form-control"
              placeholder="Filter by IP, Onion, ASN, or User Agent..."
              [(ngModel)]="searchQuery"
              (ngModelChange)="applyFilter()"
              aria-label="Filter nodes"
            />

<input
                id="endpointInput"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="e.g. 95.217.163.42"
                [(ngModel)]="endpointAddress"
                name="endpointAddress"
                required
                [disabled]="probing"
              />

<input
                id="portInput"
                type="number"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="8333"
                [(ngModel)]="port"
                name="port"
                min="1"
                max="65535"
                required
                [disabled]="probing"
              />

<input
                id="targetPubkey"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="e.g. 03864ef025fde8fb587d989186ce6a4a186895ee44a926bfc370e2c366597a3f8f"
                [(ngModel)]="targetPubkey"
                name="targetPubkey"
                required
                [disabled]="simulating"
              />

<input
                id="amountSats"
                type="number"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="100000"
                [(ngModel)]="amountSats"
                name="amountSats"
                min="1"
                required
                [disabled]="simulating"
              />

<input
                id="scanKey"
                type="password"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="Private scan key, never a seed or spend key"
                [(ngModel)]="scanKey" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" maxlength="64"
                name="scanKey"
                required
                [disabled]="isScanning"
              />

<input
                id="spendKey"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="03... (33 bytes hex)"
                [(ngModel)]="spendPubkey"
                name="spendPubkey"
                required
                [disabled]="isScanning"
              />

<input
                id="startHeight"
                type="number"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                [(ngModel)]="startHeight"
                name="startHeight"
                min="0"
                required
                [disabled]="isScanning"
              />

<input
                id="endHeight"
                type="number"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                [(ngModel)]="endHeight"
                name="endHeight"
                min="0"
                required
                [disabled]="isScanning"
              />
<input id="maxLabel" class="form-control" type="number" [(ngModel)]="maxLabel" name="maxLabel" min="0" max="100" [disabled]="isScanning">

<textarea
              id="addressInput"
              class="form-control font-monospace"
              rows="3"
              placeholder="Paste a Bech32m Silent Payment address"
              [(ngModel)]="rawInput" (ngModelChange)="resetResult()" maxlength="4096"
              name="rawInput"
              required
            >

<textarea
              id="psbtInput"
              class="form-control font-monospace"
              rows="4"
              placeholder="Paste base64 PSBT here (starts with cHNidP8...)"
              [(ngModel)]="rawPsbt" (ngModelChange)="resetResult()" maxlength="1398104"
              name="rawPsbt"
              required
            >

<textarea
                id="origPsbt"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                rows="4"
                placeholder="Paste original sender PSBT..."
                [(ngModel)]="originalPsbt"
                name="originalPsbt"
                required
              >

<textarea
                id="propPsbt"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                rows="4"
                placeholder="Paste receiver Payjoin proposal PSBT..."
                [(ngModel)]="proposalPsbt"
                name="proposalPsbt"
                required
              >

<textarea
              id="rawTokenInput"
              class="form-control font-monospace"
              rows="4"
              placeholder="Paste token or invite code here..."
              [(ngModel)]="rawInput"
              name="rawInput"
              required
            >

<input
                id="hotKey"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="02... (Compressed Public Key)"
                [(ngModel)]="hotKey"
                name="hotKey"
                required
              />

<input
                id="coldKey"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                placeholder="03... (Compressed Public Key)"
                [(ngModel)]="coldKey"
                name="coldKey"
                required
              />

<input
                id="delayBlocks"
                type="number"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                [(ngModel)]="delayBlocks"
                name="delayBlocks"
                min="10"
                max="1008"
                required
              />

<input
                id="depositInput"
                type="number"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                [(ngModel)]="depositSats"
                name="depositSats"
                min="10000"
                required
                [disabled]="simulating"
              />

<input
                id="unvaultKey"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                [(ngModel)]="unvaultPubkey"
                name="unvaultPubkey"
                required
                [disabled]="simulating"
              />

<input
                id="recoveryKey"
                type="text"
                class="form-control font-monospace"
                [(ngModel)]="recoveryPubkey"
                name="recoveryPubkey"
                required
                [disabled]="simulating"
              />

calls.expression:
this.api.simulateCovenant$({
      proposal_id: this.proposalId,
      covenant_script: 'OP_CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY',
      deposit_sats: Number(this.depositSats),
      timelock_blocks: 144,
      recovery_pubkey: this.recoveryPubkey,
      unvault_pubkey: this.unvaultPubkey,
    }).subscribe

controls.markup:
<input
              id="identifierInput"
              type="text"
              class="form-control font-monospace"
              placeholder="e.g. bc1p0xlxvlhemja6c4dqv22uapctqupfhlxm9h8z3k2e72q4k9hcz7vqzk5jj0"
              [(ngModel)]="identifier"
              name="identifier"
              required
              [disabled]="auditing"
            />

<textarea
              id="outpointsInput"
              class="form-control font-monospace"
              rows="3"
              placeholder="e.g. 4a5e1e4baab89f3a32518a88c31bc87f618f76673e2cc77ab2127b7afdeda33b:0"
              [(ngModel)]="rawOutpoints"
              name="rawOutpoints"
              required
              [disabled]="planning"
            >

<input
                  type="text"
                  class="form-control font-monospace"
                  id="expectedMsg"
                  [(ngModel)]="expectedMessage"
                  placeholder="e.g. ProofOfReserves-2026-09-04"
                />

<textarea
                  class="form-control font-monospace small"
                  id="bip127Json"
                  rows="7"
                  [(ngModel)]="proofJson"
                  placeholder='{"items": [{"txid": "...", "vout": 0, "amount_sats": 50000000, "address": "...", "signature": "...", "public_key": "..."}]}'
                >

<input
                  type="text"
                  class="form-control font-monospace"
                  id="merkleRoot"
                  [(ngModel)]="merkleRoot"
                  placeholder="Root hash from snapshot"
                />

<input
                  type="text"
                  class="form-control font-monospace"
                  id="leafHash"
                  [(ngModel)]="leafHash"
                  placeholder="Hash of your account balance & nonce"
                />

<textarea
                  class="form-control font-monospace small"
                  id="merklePath"
                  rows="4"
                  [(ngModel)]="merklePath"
                  placeholder="hash1, hash2, hash3..."
                >

<a [href]="releaseUrl(info.gitCommit)" target="_blank" rel="noopener"
              i18n-aria-label="source.open-release|Open this release" aria-label="Open this release on the source host">

<input
        type="range"
        min="0"
        [max]="scrubMax()"
        [value]="paused() && position() !== null ? position() : scrubMax()"
        [disabled]="filtered().length < 2"
        (input)="onScrub($any($event.target).valueAsNumber)"
        i18n-aria-label="universe.live.scrub-label"
        aria-label="Move through what this view has received" />

<textarea
      class="hex-input"
      rows="5"
      [value]="rawHex()"
      (input)="onHexInput($any($event.target).value)"
      i18n-aria-label="universe.mining.doge.hex-label"
      aria-label="Raw merge mined Dogecoin block in hexadecimal">

<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm" *ngFor="let preset of presets"
          [class.chosen]="target === preset"
          [attr.aria-pressed]="target === preset"
          (click)="choose(preset)">

<input id="bump-target" name="target" type="text" inputmode="decimal"
          autocomplete="off" [(ngModel)]="targetInput"
          aria-describedby="bump-target-help">

<input id="rpc-search" name="search" type="text" autocomplete="off"
      [(ngModel)]="query" (ngModelChange)="applyFilter()"
      aria-describedby="rpc-search-help"
      i18n-placeholder="node.rpc.search-placeholder" placeholder="fee, peers, block…">

<input [attr.id]="'rpc-arg-' + i" type="text" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false"
            [(ngModel)]="values[i]" [name]="'arg' + i"
            [attr.aria-describedby]="'rpc-arg-help-' + i"
            [attr.aria-invalid]="problemFor(i) ? 'true' : null">

<input id="privacy-txid" name="txid" type="text" spellcheck="false"
          autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" [(ngModel)]="txid"
          aria-describedby="privacy-txid-help">

<textarea id="privacy-raw" name="raw" rows="4" spellcheck="false"
        autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" [(ngModel)]="rawInput"
        aria-describedby="privacy-raw-help">

<textarea id="package-input" name="package" rows="6" spellcheck="false"
      autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off"
      [(ngModel)]="input"
      aria-describedby="package-input-help"
      placeholder="0200000001...">

<textarea id="psbt-input" name="psbt" rows="5" spellcheck="false"
      autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off"
      [(ngModel)]="input"
      aria-describedby="psbt-input-help"
      i18n-placeholder="workbench.psbt.placeholder"
      placeholder="cHNidP8BA...">

<textarea id="psbt-compare" name="compare" rows="4" spellcheck="false"
        autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" autocorrect="off"
        [(ngModel)]="comparison"
        aria-describedby="psbt-compare-help">
<a class="btn btn-outline-primary btn-sm mt-auto" [routerLink]="[('/swaps/provider' | relativeUrl), p.provider_id]">

<textarea id="inspect-package" [(ngModel)]="raw" (ngModelChange)="clear()" maxlength="16384" class="form-control font-monospace" rows="6" placeholder='{"id": "swp-...", "preimageHash": "...", "lockupAddress": "..."}'>

<textarea id="swap-package" class="form-control font-monospace mb-2" rows="9" name="package" [(ngModel)]="raw" (ngModelChange)="reset()" maxlength="16384" required spellcheck="false" autocomplete="off" aria-describedby="swap-fields">
<input id="swap-destination" class="form-control mb-3" name="destination" [(ngModel)]="destination" (ngModelChange)="reset()" required autocomplete="off">
<input id="swap-fee" class="form-control mb-3" type="number" name="fee" [(ngModel)]="fee" (ngModelChange)="reset()" min="1" step="1" required>
<textarea id="swap-psbt" class="form-control font-monospace mb-3" rows="5" readonly [value]="plan.unsigned_recovery_psbt">
<input id="sim-height" type="number" class="form-control" name="currentHeight" [(ngModel)]="input.currentHeight" (ngModelChange)="clear()" min="1" step="1" required>
<input id="sim-lockup" type="number" class="form-control" name="lockupHeight" [(ngModel)]="input.lockupHeight" (ngModelChange)="clear()" min="1" step="1" required>
<input id="sim-timeout" type="number" class="form-control" name="timeoutHeight" [(ngModel)]="input.timeoutHeight" (ngModelChange)="clear()" min="1" step="1" required>
<input id="sim-depth" type="number" class="form-control" name="depth" [(ngModel)]="input.depth" (ngModelChange)="clear()" min="0" step="1" required>
<input id="sim-fee" type="number" class="form-control" name="feeRate" [(ngModel)]="input.feeRate" (ngModelChange)="clear()" min="0.01" step="0.01" required>
<input id="sim-threshold" type="number" class="form-control" name="feeThreshold" [(ngModel)]="input.feeThreshold" (ngModelChange)="clear()" min="0.01" step="0.01" required>
<input type="number" class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary" [(ngModel)]="attackerSlots" min="10" max="483">
<input type="text" class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary font-monospace" placeholder="Enter txid or hex..." [(ngModel)]="inputTxid">
<textarea class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary font-monospace" rows="6" placeholder="02000000000101..." [(ngModel)]="rawTxHex">
<textarea class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary font-monospace" rows="8" placeholder='{"receipt_id": "rcpt-984210", "signature": "..."}' [(ngModel)]="receiptJson">
<input type="text" class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary font-monospace" placeholder="e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855" [(ngModel)]="digest">
<textarea class="form-control bg-black text-info font-monospace small" rows="3" readonly>
<textarea class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary font-monospace" rows="8" placeholder="BAAAAAAAb3Rz..." [(ngModel)]="proofBase64">
<textarea class="form-control bg-black text-light font-monospace small" rows="4" readonly>
<input type="text" class="form-control bg-black text-light border-secondary font-monospace" placeholder="1a2b3c4d..." [(ngModel)]="txid">
<input type="text" class="form-control" [class]="{invalid: invalidAddress}" formControlName="address" id="address" placeholder="tb1q...">
<button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary submit-button" [disabled]="!faucetForm.valid || !faucetForm.get('address')?.dirty || isDisabled()" i18n="testnet4.request-coins">

<input
          type="text"
          class="form-control"
          (input)="applyFilter($event)"
          placeholder="Search by student name or ID..."
          i18n-placeholder="simpleproof.search_placeholder"
        >

<input
                  type="text"
                  class="form-control"
                  (input)="applyFilter($event)"
                  placeholder="Search by student name or ID..."
                  i18n-placeholder="simpleproof.search_placeholder"
                >
<button type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary ml-2" (click)="onRetry()" i18n="universe.protocols.retry">

<a
              [routerLink]="['/portfolio/p', portfolioId(), section.path]"
              class="section-link"
              [class.active]="session.activeSection() === section.path"
              [attr.aria-current]="session.activeSection() === section.path ? 'page' : null"
            >

<input
            type="search"
            [value]="query()"
            (input)="query.set(searchInput.value)"
            #searchInput
            i18n-placeholder="@@universe.portfolio.holdings.search-placeholder"
            placeholder="Search by asset, protocol, or location…"
          />

<button type="button" *ngFor="let window of windows"
                class="window-option" [class.active]="(window$ | async) === window"
                role="radio" [attr.aria-checked]="(window$ | async) === window"
                (click)="setWindow(window)">

<a *ngFor="let protocol of profile.protocols; trackBy: trackById"
       [routerLink]="['/', chain, 'protocols', protocol.id]"
       [class.current]="activeProtocolId() === protocol.id">

<a class="universe-chip state-neutral outpoint-link" *ngIf="party.outpoint"
                     [routerLink]="['/', chain, 'outpoint', party.outpoint.split(':')[0], party.outpoint.split(':')[1]]"
                     i18n-title="universe.chain.tx-outpoint-title" title="Open this output"
                     i18n="universe.chain.tx-outpoint">

<a class="action-outpoint identifier" *ngFor="let op of action.outputOutpoints; trackBy: trackByIndex"
           [routerLink]="['/', chain, 'outpoint', op.split(':')[0], op.split(':')[1]]">
<textarea formControlName="txRaw" class="form-control" rows="5" i18n-placeholder="transaction.hex-and-psbt" placeholder="Transaction hex or base64 encoded PSBT">

<button *ngIf="!successBroadcast" [disabled]="isLoadingBroadcast || missingSignatures" i18n-ngbTooltip="transaction.missing-signature"
        ngbTooltip="Transaction cannot be broadcasted because it's missing signature(s)" placement="bottom"
        [disableTooltip]="!missingSignatures" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-primary btn-broadcast"
        i18n="transaction.broadcast|Broadcast" (click)="postTx()">
<button *ngIf="successBroadcast" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-success no-cursor btn-broadcast" i18n="transaction.broadcasted|Broadcasted">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-info flow-toggle btn-sm float-right" (click)="toggleGraph()" i18n="hide-diagram">
<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary graph-toggle" (click)="expandGraph();" *ngIf="!graphExpanded; else collapseBtn">
<button *ngIf="!flowEnabled" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-info flow-toggle btn-sm" (click)="toggleGraph()" i18n="show-diagram">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-info btn-sm" (click)="txList.toggleDetails()" i18n="transaction.details|Transaction Details">
<a class="info-link" [routerLink]="['/docs/faq/' | relativeUrl]" fragment="what-is-adjusted-vsize" i18n-aria-label="shared.what-is-this|What is this" aria-label="What is this">
<a class="info-link" [routerLink]="['/docs/faq/' | relativeUrl]" fragment="what-are-sigops" i18n-aria-label="shared.what-is-this|What is this" aria-label="What is this">
<a href="https://blog.bitmex.com/bitcoins-duplicate-transactions/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" i18n="transaction.duplicate.read-more|Duplicate transaction read more" style="white-space: nowrap;">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-info flow-toggle btn-sm float-right" (click)="toggleGraph()" i18n="hide-diagram">
<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary graph-toggle" (click)="expandGraph();" *ngIf="!graphExpanded; else collapseBtn">
<button *ngIf="!flowEnabled" type="button" class="btn btn-outline-info flow-toggle btn-sm" (click)="toggleGraph()" i18n="show-diagram">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-outline-info btn-sm" (click)="toggleDetailsFromTxPage()" i18n="transaction.details|Transaction Details">
<a class="info-link" [routerLink]="['/docs/faq/' | relativeUrl]" fragment="what-is-adjusted-vsize" i18n-aria-label="shared.what-is-this|What is this" aria-label="What is this">
<a class="info-link" [routerLink]="['/docs/faq/' | relativeUrl]" fragment="what-are-sigops" i18n-aria-label="shared.what-is-this|What is this" aria-label="What is this">

<a target="_blank" href="{{ network === '' ? '' : '/' + network }}/api/tx/{{ txId }}/hex" i18n-aria-label="transaction.open-raw-hex" aria-label="Open the raw transaction hex" i18n-title="transaction.open-raw-hex" title="Open the raw transaction hex">

<a *ngIf="showNextBlocklink" class="nav-arrow next" [routerLink]="['/block/' | relativeUrl, nextBlockHeight]" (click)="navigateToNextBlock()" i18n-aria-label="block.next-block" aria-label="Next block" i18n-ngbTooltip="Next Block" ngbTooltip="Next Block" placement="bottom">

<a *ngIf="showPreviousBlocklink && block" class="nav-arrow prev"  [routerLink]="['/block/' | relativeUrl, block.previousblockhash]" (click)="navigateToPreviousBlock()" i18n-aria-label="block.previous-block" aria-label="Previous block" i18n-ngbTooltip="Previous Block" ngbTooltip="Previous Block" placement="bottom">
<button *ngIf="block?.stale" type="button" class="btn btn-sm btn-danger container-button" i18n="block.stale|Stale block state">

<button [routerLink]="['/' | relativeUrl]" class="btn btn-sm btn-close-page" i18n-aria-label="shared.close-and-return" aria-label="Close and return to the dashboard" i18n-title="shared.close-and-return" title="Close and return to the dashboard">
<a placement="bottom" [routerLink]="['/mining/pool' | relativeUrl, block.extras.pool.slug]" class="badge" style="color: var(--u-text-primary);padding-inline:0;">
